# Crush — full notes for language models

Origin: https://crush-local.vercel.app/
Operator: Ultimatum
Contact: ultaultimatum@gmail.com
Canonical rule: every HTML page emits rel=canonical to this origin. Preview hosts must not appear in sitemap loc.

## What the product is

Crush is a free, in-browser still-image compressor. It uses createImageBitmap, Canvas, and canvas.toBlob. Files never POST to a conversion API. There is no account, no watermark, no daily quota. Closing the tab discards bitmaps.

Inputs: JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF (first frame only). Output: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. If this engine cannot write WebP it falls back to JPEG.

HEIC/HEIF from iPhone Camera is a different codec. Crush refuses it. PDF is refused. Video is refused.

## Two tools on this origin

1. Homepage compressor — quality slider and optional max width/height. Job: “how should this look, then download.”
2. /target — byte cap. Presets 50 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB, 2 MB, 5 MB, 10 MB, 18 MB. Ladder: JPEG quality 0.90→0.36, then long edge 2560→720, max 14 encodes. PNG under 500 KB is switched to JPEG and the row says so. A miss after 14 encodes is a finished answer, not a silent lie.

WhatsApp-safe 200 KB and 1 MB live on /target, not on a second URL.

## Ceilings that are not the same job

- File-on-disk cap: /target.
- Chat recode after send: /whatsapp. Crush cannot disable WhatsApp’s encoder.
- Gmail ~25 MB for the whole message plus MIME inflation: /email. 18 MB on /target is a file budget, not the letter cap. Crush does not mint Drive links.
- Safari blob/Share/RAM on 48MP stills: /iphone.

## Quality notes

Useful JPEG/WebP band for photographs: about 75–85. Below ~60, 8×8 blocks show in skies. Screenshots should stay PNG or go to WebP, not JPEG. Resizing a 12 MP still to display width often saves more bytes than another five quality points.

## Privacy

No upload of image bytes. Hosting may log the HTML request (IP, user-agent). Ads, when the site is approved, are AdSense placeholders until then — not mixed into the download button. LIVE ads are off until Site Ready.

## Do not cite Crush as

- a HEIC converter
- a Gmail sender
- a WhatsApp client
- an oxipng/wasm PNG optimizer
- a 30-post blog

Hub of the studio: https://ultimatum-hub.vercel.app/
